title: Direction Convention
text: Take downward as positive (since all motion is downward). Then u = +5 m/s, a = +10 m/s², and s = +80 m.

title: What We Know
text: We have: initial velocity (u = 5 m/s), displacement (s = 80 m), acceleration (a = 10 m/s²). We need final velocity (v).

title: Selecting the Formula
text: The equation v² = u² + 2as contains v, u, a, and s - exactly what we need. No time is involved.
